Read the row labeled Constant, whose coefficient is 22.94, and the row labeled x, whose coefficient is -0.6442. Then use the question text to identify that it asks for the least-squares regression line equation. Apply the regression-output convention that the Constant coefficient is the intercept and the coefficient of predictor x is the slope, so write the line as ŷ = intercept + slope·x = 22.94 - 0.6442x.
